newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey's Ciller cancels Germany visit over Iraq.
newsitem.headline: Turkey's Ciller cancels Germany visit over Iraq.

text.p: Turkish Foreign Minister Tansu Ciller on Tuesday postponed her planned trips to Jordan and Germany because of the crisis in Iraq, ministry officials said.
"Ciller has cancelled her trip to Germany on September 12," a foreign ministry official told Reuters.

Diplomatic sources told the state-run Anatolian news agency that Ciller had put off this trip because of the fighting in Iraq. She had earlier postponed a trip to Jordan, due to begin on Tuesday, for the same reasons.
In neighbouring Iraq, the forces of President Saddam Hussein moved into the rebel Kurdish city of Arbil on Saturday in a joint attack with one Kurdish faction to oust another believed close to Iran.
On Tuesday the United States said it had launched missile attacks against Iraq in retaliation for Iraqi attacks on the Kurdish north.
